summary: Two snowmobilers triggered an ~800-ft-wide avalanche between the Middle Fork of the Swan River and Georgia Pass; one rider was buried ~4 ft deep and killed. More than 30 rescuers, two dog teams and a helicopter responded.
location: Northwest of Glacier Peak, Middle Fork Swan River
notes: Victim identity not publicly released at the time of reporting (Aspen Times via SnowBrains). Slide grew to 800 ft wide and ran 2,000+ ft, triggering a second slide that merged. Date Tuesday 2018-04-10.
